role: weighted search instance with hidden graph and revealed information
notes: Mathematical descriptor; the whole adjacency structure is not supplied to comparison algorithms.

role: directed state graph
notes: Distinct from its path-unfolding tree.

role: set of goal states
notes: A state's goal flag is revealed on generation.

role: nonnegative edge cost
notes: A positive uniform lower bound is imposed only in stated infinite-domain theorems.

role: cost of a persistent path record
notes: Typed by path argument; additive edge sum.

role: current best discovered cost label of a state
notes: Typed by state argument; updates strictly decrease the label.

role: least start-to-state cost or infimum
notes: Actual graph cost; not generally the current label.

role: nonnegative normalized heuristic estimate
notes: Admissibility and consistency are separate properties.

role: least remaining goal cost or infinity
notes: Infinity is permitted at dead ends.

role: optimal cost for the currently specified solution-cost functional
notes: Initially additive h*(s); the generalized block declares the minimum under C(P). Attainment is stated before use.

role: persistent witnessing path record
notes: Old witnesses do not silently change when labels are updated.

role: A-star selection score g plus h
notes: Not a path cost at arbitrary non-goals.

role: map to a relaxed search problem
notes: Must preserve goals and simulate each edge at no greater cost.

role: exact relaxed remaining cost as a unary function
notes: An arbitrary relaxed feasible solution is not this value; distinguish the later binary revealed-graph distance.

role: set of distinct non-goal states expanded
notes: Excludes goal selection without successor generation and does not count re-expansions twice.

role: states reachable by a strict optimal-cost contour
notes: Initial non-goal state included; goals excluded.

role: maximum g-plus-h prefix score of a path record
notes: Used for A-double-star selection; duplicate dominance still uses g.

role: set of graph states
notes: The finite-graph theorems assume this set finite.

role: directed graph edge relation
notes: Typed differently from the expansion-set notation \(E_A(I)\).

role: initial search state
notes: A single initial seed is used for oracle-expansion comparisons.

role: current unexpanded or reopened state labels
notes: Obsolete heap entries are not members of this current-label set.

role: states processed at their current label
notes: Strictly improving labels reopen a state.

role: positive uniform lower bound on edge costs
notes: Not imposed in the finite nonnegative-cost results.

role: goal-preferring tie policy
notes: Its quantifier position is part of every comparison.

role: domain of admissible solvable finite instances
notes: Entire-domain correctness defines competitor membership.

role: consistent subdomain of admissible finite instances
notes: Goal normalization is retained.

role: algorithms optimal on all admissible finite instances
notes: No ungenerated-graph oracle is available.

role: normalized admissible path-only best-first class
notes: Goal scores equal actual path cost; duplicate merging requires continuation-safe dominance.

role: normalized competitor path score
notes: Typed by path argument; distinct from the example state named b.

role: two-input competitor scoring function
notes: Inputs are current path cost and endpoint heuristic.

role: finite graph of exposed successor lists
notes: Unexpanded non-goals have no outgoing edges in the adversarial completion.

role: shortest-path distance in the exposed graph
notes: Equality to current labels is established only after all needed relaxations.

role: finite start-rooted path record
notes: A graph state and a path occurrence are different objects. Accepted additive-cost witnesses are simple.

role: prefix ending at a specified path occurrence
notes: Occurrences distinguish repeated appearances of a state in generalized records.

role: heuristic induced by an exact relaxed remaining cost
notes: \(h_R(v)=d_R(\rho(v))\); goal and edge simulations supply its certificate.

role: tentative additive cost in an A-star edge relaxation
notes: Local scalar proposal g(u)+c(u,v), distinct from the later function q(P).

role: fully relaxed revealed-graph path-barrier algorithm
notes: Explicit strengthened procedure, not an assertion that pending-reopening A** already performs cost closure.

role: currently revealed directed graph
notes: Contains all revealed successor lists and generated vertices; initially one vertex and no edges.

role: set of non-goals with revealed successor lists
notes: Cached-edge propagation through D is not an additional distinct-state expansion.

role: generated frontier states outside D
notes: Goals remain frontier candidates until return.

role: binary shortest-path distance in the revealed graph R
notes: Different argument type from the earlier unary relaxed goal-distance function.

role: barrier of the next newly selected state
notes: The positive-cost proof separately handles g<m and g=m.

role: flat minimum-barrier frontier with cost equal to m
notes: All members have heuristic zero under the stated positive-domain tie rule.

role: general finite path evaluation score
notes: Each evaluation terminates; merging requires continuation-safe order preservation.

role: specified possibly nonadditive solution cost
notes: No relation to the path score is assumed until a strictly increasing goal-score transform is specified.

role: largest noninitial score on a goal record
notes: The forced initial selection is excluded from this barrier.

role: minimum attained noninitial goal-path barrier
notes: Assumed finite and attained; gives the effective post-root expansion threshold.

role: minmax including the forced initial score
notes: M=max(q((s)),mu); retaining this source quantity does not make it the sharper expansion threshold.

role: strictly increasing map from solution cost to goal score
notes: The inverse bound is used only where its inverse value exists.

role: path-dependent modulation of heuristic weight
notes: Only its upper bound along an optimal path is used for the stated return-quality ratio.

role: nonnegative relative-error factor in the weighted score
notes: Adversarial proofs separately quantify positive local perturbations of the same glyph.

role: multiplicative upper bound on heuristic error along an optimal path
notes: May exceed one; the separate weighted admissibility condition remains explicit.

role: convex weighting parameter of g and h
notes: Zero is allowed; one is excluded because normalized goal scores must preserve strict cost order.

role: increasing concave bijection of nonnegative reals fixing zero
notes: Its inverse supplies the nonlinear score construction.

role: inverse function of the concave score generator phi
notes: Local function role; not the ordered-tree vertex r or right-side barrier r(n).

role: maximum future score on the returned record beyond position i
notes: Evaluations on divergent continuations retain the whole start-rooted prefix.

role: finite rooted tree with ordered children and terminal goals
notes: Pure-leftmost tie priority applies only in this section.

role: score at the unique root-to-u record in the ordered tree
notes: Abbreviation of q(P) available because the tree path is unique.

role: minimum goal-path maximum inside a subtree rooted at r
notes: Both endpoints included; infinity denotes a subtree with no goal.

role: minimum barrier of eligible left side subtrees
notes: Side branches occur at strict ancestors of n, with empty minimum infinity.

role: minimum barrier of eligible right side subtrees
notes: Function notation differs from the locally bound subtree root r.

role: largest strict-contour score in the nonpathological trade proof
notes: Local real scalar, distinct from the expanded-set D of the saturated algorithm.

role: maximum A-star prefix score on a competing-score witness path
notes: Includes the initial score under the explicit h(s)<C* premise.

role: largest noninitial competitor score on that witness path
notes: The two-goal counterexample places a goal cost strictly between \(Q\) and \(Q_b\).

role: largest A-star score along one fixed solution path
notes: A finite upper bound used even when the heuristic overestimates.

role: cost of a cheapest goal path in the currently revealed graph
notes: The early-return certificate compares this feasible cost with the simulated OPEN barrier.

role: strictly positive appended-edge slack
notes: Chosen below the remaining strict cost gap.

role: strictly positive cost gap in an exposed-graph completion
notes: Chosen between zero and C*-D.

role: strictly positive perturbation for costwise comparison
notes: The modified instance need not retain heuristic admissibility.

role: small strictly positive terminal-edge cost for a flat frontier group
notes: Chosen below every finite positive gap to the current barrier.

role: smaller positive terminal-edge perturbation
notes: Used to force inspection of every still unqueried member of the flat group.

role: positive perturbation keeping a comparison instance inside the positive-cost domain
notes: Its bound preserves the strict inequalities in the finite counterexample.
